instruction:
Treat a placeholder-containing template `/home/user/Desktop/re_scan_base.py` as the starting point. Run your scripts with Python in a legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN environment (e.g. `from dolfin import *`). For the steps below, run legacy FEniCS with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python` when working on `re_scan_base.py`.

Complete parameterized batch scanning: 1. Use Python or shell script to generate 3 files from the template: - `/home/user/Desktop/re_100.py` (`Re=100`) - `/home/user/Desktop/re_400.py` (`Re=400`) - `/home/user/Desktop/re_1000.py` (`Re=1000`) 2. Run all 3 independent solves. 3. In each script, extract X-direction velocity at geometric center `(0.5, 0.5)` and write `Re, center_ux` to its corresponding result file: `/home/user/Desktop/re_100.result`, `/home/user/Desktop/re_400.result`, or `/home/user/Desktop/re_1000.result`. 4. Write summary script `/home/user/Desktop/summarize.py` to read all 3 result files: - Output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `Re, center_ux`
